limitations: No claim of complete write support. Navigation/conditional menus remain in GOODWE_SOLARGO_MENU_SURVEY.json.
Safety raw values are diagnostic, not validated physical settings. PQ bank is all FFFF on target.
No arbitrary changes to grid protection, battery chemistry, credentials or network configuration.
The new scalar writer is client-side. Native app proxy write-through and correlated deferred replies are not implemented.

deployment.scope: Historical deployment evidence for this profile implementation; not a claim about the current Pi runtime

legacy_es.workflow_count_limit: 29 counts entries with the workflow-not-implemented status only. Mapped read-only working-mode, battery-selection, schedule and safety items also lack setters.
legacy_es.survey_scope: GW5048D-ES, DSP23/ARM14, SolarGo 7.2.2. Other-model branches and all catalogue selections were not exhaustively exercised.

house_spn.runtime_evidence: Pi slot213 was healthy during the recovery investigation but lacked goodwe-control. Source/profile declarations do not prove current runtime control capability.

required_completion: Audit house SPN firmware and menu applicability separately from legacy ES.
Implement multi-step working-mode, battery-selection and schedule transactions with coupling, validation, readback and persistence checks.
Bind 5A5A module identity, diagnostics and network data, and implement its length-prefixed credential/network commit transactions.
Implement actions and conditional fields from the app survey with model-specific preconditions and response handling.
Complete safety decoding, sentinel handling and target validity before exposing physical writable settings.
Resolve reserve reversion and physically characterize independent solar/battery control semantics and failover.
Implement correlated proxy write-through against the shared Device and verify deployed runtime capabilities.

pr_implementation.common_watchdog: PowerControl.watchdog with explicit feed counter and controller-scoped lease
pr_implementation.limitations: Historical completion_audit records the pre-PR baseline. Complete menu/write coverage on both inverters, compound commits, hardware failover and independent hybrid control remain outstanding.
pr_implementation.native_readonly_validation: Real native identity and20% on/off-grid reserve readbacks observed through write-blocking relay. Timeouts remain recorded. No physical configuration writes in this pass.
pr_implementation.action_result: ACK only; no physical completion or persistence claim
proxy_wire_families: 5A5A module families1/2 (family2 ACK shape only emulated)
pr_implementation.proxy_validation: Peer isolation, identity override, upstream exception, client recreation and pending cancellation emulator tests; guarded physical reads only
pr_implementation.module_password_workflow: Typed UDP form: family2/01 and family1/0C reload; ACKs only, physical credential/reconnect validation outstanding
pr_implementation.battery_catalogue_commit_reference: Typed low745 form and explicit-catalogue console generator; other model branches remain separate
pr_implementation.privacy_reminder_source_trace: App policy/module eligibility and per-serial dismissal; not an inverter password-status register
pr_implementation.native_low745_scope: Observed GW6000ES20 single-battery non-EOA branch; fourteen staged fields and seven ordered writes
pr_implementation.module_network_workflow: Typed UDP form: family1/0B network, family1/0A length-prefixed credentials, family1/0C reload; current client address unchanged
pr_implementation.native_apn_workflow: Ordinary UDP FC16/47041,count25; U16 byte length plus name/padding; cloud/BLE separate
pr_implementation.empty_text_write_semantics: Boxed empty-string/null clears a text element to an empty present value; validity remains explicit
pr_implementation.legacy_mode_selector_encoding: Off-grid sets relay selector3 ->0030 and store selector0 ->04; expected repliesA7/A6

pr_implementation.full_unit_suite: Build passes; Windows run stops at pre-existing manager.console.command:626 temporary-file assertion before profile unit tests
